title: Another Word for "Ensure": 3 Better Words #shorts
description:
Another word for "ensure" in English. Don't just say "Ensure". Here are three better words:
• Secure. (to make it certain)
• Guarantee. (to promise a result)
• See to it. (to make it happen)
